column1: # Forever loot of the Stockade (The Stockade, map 34): the boss drop and quest reward rows (spec jvbastel/WOWAI#240,
# ticket #247). The items are in loot_stockade_items.tsv. The layout of the loot files is in forever/REFRESH.md,
# "Dungeon loot". forever/generator writes a drop row into forever_creature_loot_template: a copy of every stock row
# of the loot entry plus the new row, outside the stock equal-chance group, with patch_min 0 (the Stockade is open
# from patch 0). A reward row becomes a forever_quest_template copy of the stock quest with the Forever reward choices.
# Sources, read 2026-10-31: Wowhead's Forever tooltip data ("Dropped by" and "Drop Chance" of each item,
# (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=<id>, read with a web-fetch tool: notes/forever/dungeon-loot-research.md 7.3,
# summaries in notes/forever/wowhead-cache/quest). A drop is confirmed when the tooltip's "Dropped by" names the boss;
# its chance is the tooltip's "Drop Chance". Every new drop of the Stockade is confirmed.
# Quests 387, 388 and 391 have no item reward in stock or on Wowhead Forever: no row. No Stockade quest reward
# lost a class lock (the stock items have allowable_class -1).
# Stock boss drops keep their stock chance (spec #240): Bruegal Ironknuckle has no drop row, and Kam Deepfury's
# reference loot 30098 stays stock (his new drops go into his creature loot).
# Each boss's loot entry is its creature entry (stock creature_template.loot_id).
#   kind        drop: a new item on a boss; reward: a new reward choice of a quest (replaces "-") or a swapped one;
#               unlock: the quest reward item loses its class lock (the item needs a row in the items file)
#   item        the item ID (a row of a loot items file, or a stock item)
#   target      drop: the boss (creature entry); reward, unlock: the quest ID
#   targetName  the stock name of the boss or the title of the quest (the generator compares it)
#   loot        drop: "creature" (the boss's creature loot entry) or "reference <ID>" (a reference loot entry that only
#   chance      drop: the drop chance in percent; else "-"
#   replaces    reward: the stock reward choice it replaces, or "-" to add it in the first empty choice slot; else "-"
#   count       reward: the number of items; else "-"
#   status      confirmed, unconfirmed or unreadable (the generator leaves the row out and lists it); a drop can
#               also be left-out: confirmed, but kept out on purpose (a Forever camp blueprint), listed with its boss,
#   date        the day the source was read, YYYY-MM-DD
